## Change

Describe the affected story, tasks, and scope.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run check` passes.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` describes user-visible changes (or explain why not).
- [ ] The scoped baton validates and acceptance checks have evidence.
- [ ] No vendored upstream files were hand-edited; any upstream bump went through `baton sync`.
- [ ] Maintainer workflows retain source-repository guards and SHA-pinned actions.
